introduction.title: Arrange rows for queries across several dimensions
paragraphs: Lindel maps an array of numeric coordinates to one integer using a Hilbert or Morton space-filling curve. Sorting by that integer places many nearby points close together in the stored row order.

Use it when writing Parquet for queries that filter several dimensions, such as location and time. A useful ordering can make row-group statistics more selective and let readers skip more data. The benefit depends on your coordinate scaling, data distribution, and query filters.
